description: Search current news when the user asks about recent events, announcements, or coverage. Returns citable article results with title, URL, snippet, and optional extracted text.

crawl_results.description: Number of top articles to retrieve as full pages. Each successful retrieval adds 1 credit to the base 1-credit news request

max_results.description: How many articles the answer needs; a handful suits most questions, more suits broad coverage

search_service.description: News engine to use; hackernews returns Hacker News discussions instead of publisher articles

time_range.description: Only return articles published within this window; use day for breaking news

name: news

results.description: Matching sources, most relevant first; read any url in full with crawl

id.description: Stable identifier for this result; for web results this is the canonical URL

text.description: Result snippet or extracted page text when available

url.description: Canonical URL that clients can cite and users can open

title: News search
